name: Everyday Tote
description: The one you reach for on your way out. A roomy canvas carryall for the market, the office, and the unplanned stop in between.
materials: Heavyweight cotton canvas with reinforced handles.
care: Spot clean with mild soap. Air dry.
note: Room for the everyday, and a little more.

name: Studio Mug
description: A good morning starts with a familiar shape. This softly rounded ceramic mug makes a little room for your daily ritual.
materials: Glazed stoneware with a comfortable loop handle.
care: Hand washing recommended. Let hot drinks cool before handling.
note: For the first cup, and the one after.

name: Transit Bottle
description: A simple refill for days that move. A matte finish and a clean, compact shape make this bottle an easy daily companion.
materials: Double-wall stainless steel with a screw-top cap.
care: Hand wash. Leave open to dry. Not microwave safe.

name: Daily Notebook
description: For plans, passing thoughts, and things worth remembering. A cloth-bound notebook with room to think on paper.
materials: Cloth cover, cream paper, and a ribbon page marker.
care: Keep dry. Make it your own.
note: A small place for big ideas.

name: Catchall Tray
description: Keys, coins, the little things. An understated wooden tray that gives everyday objects a place to land.
materials: Oak-tone wood with a smooth, natural finish.
care: Wipe clean with a dry cloth. Do not soak.
note: A little order, without the effort.

name: Linen Tea Towel
description: A quiet workhorse for the kitchen. Soft texture, a simple stripe, and a loop that keeps it close at hand.
materials: Linen and cotton blend with a hanging loop.
care: Machine wash cool with like colors. Line dry.

name: Cedar Candle
description: A softer ending to the day. A warm cedar-inspired candle in an amber vessel that sits comfortably in any corner.
materials: Sample wax blend in an amber glass vessel.
care: Never leave a lit candle unattended. Keep away from children and flammable items.

name: Desk Pouch
description: Bring a little order to your bag. A compact zip pouch for pens, cables, and the small essentials that travel with you.
materials: Cotton canvas with a metal zipper.
care: Spot clean and air dry. Do not machine dry.
